scope: SpaceMiT K1, single-core warm inference, INT8 W8A8/qd8 whole-model comparison; lower latency is better

models.note: Accepted full-output Merlin champion. ExecuTorch is the identity-matched N=1/N=4 warm slope.

models.source: Merlin: out/artifacts/measurements/k1_spacemit/small_llama_int8_consistent/mr248_lmul4_interleaved_c1_20260907.json (MR4 median of three full-output launches); ExecuTorch qd8 warm slope derived from out/artifacts/measurements/k1_spacemit/small_llama/cross_framework_v1_20260905T081335Z_b24eeca/baseline_result.json (N=1, total=5.174957 ms) and cross_framework_v1_20260905T081411Z_b24eeca/baseline_result.json (N=4, total=10.816588 ms): (total4-total1)/3
models.note: MR4 is the measured per-model winner over MR2 and MR8; all nine interleaved launches are full-output and bit-exact across arms. Both frameworks use dynamic-activation/per-channel-weight INT8. The peer ratio remains diagnostic because ExecuTorch was captured separately.
Full 256k-output run. Merlin is the best of three interleaved launches; ExecuTorch is the fresh identity-matched N=1/N=4 warm slope.
Merlin exceeded the 120 s single-inference deadline; 120000 ms is a lower bound, not a completed measurement. ExecuTorch is an N=1/N=4 warm slope using a recomputed seeded-random fp32 reference.

blocked_backend.reason: No W8A8 Merlin+XNNPACK measurement exists: the qd8 board shim is intentionally fail-closed until its dynamic activation quantization, qc8w packing, RVV call ABI, and quantization-aware correctness gate are validated on K1.

comparability: Diagnostic, not a paired certification set. Model identity and validation are strongest for LSTMNetVIT and TinyLLaMA; SmallLLaMA combines a recorded Merlin result with a separate fresh ExecuTorch pair; SmolVLA uses a timeout lower bound and a seeded-random ExecuTorch reference.
